title: Constructible dimensions from coherent base change
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a
projective morphism with
Noetherian base and let
$\mathcal G$ be a coherent module
flat over $S$.
For each $r\geq0$, the function
$s\mapsto\dim_{\kappa(\bar s)} H^r(X_{\bar s},\mathcal G_{\bar s})$, with
coherent cohomology, is constructible.

proof.text: Since f is projective, it is locally of finite type and X is locally Noetherian. Coherence gives quasi-coherence and finite type by [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth]. On each affine open its sections form a finite module by [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-affine-sections-finite], hence a finitely presented module over its Noetherian coordinate ring. The affine presentation equivalence of [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-finite-type-affine] and descent of finite presentation give G.IsFinitePresentation. Package local Noetherianity and compactness as IsNoetherian S.

Choose the closed immersion into finite projective space supplied by projectivity. Apply the existing source-library theorem Scheme.Modules.finite_range_and_isConstructible_finrankH_geometricFibre in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Cohomology.DirectImage.GeometricFibreRank to G and degree r. This theorem already proves this blueprint result for the source-library H convention: its proof identifies geometric dimensions with residue-field dimensions, uses upper semicontinuity [thm-pc-semicontinuity-base-change], and obtains finite range and constructible level sets on the Noetherian base. Use its function as beta. This invokes an existing proved implementation rather than reconstructing perfect models.

The tensor-formula pullback and the source-library ordinary pullback are left adjoint to the same pushforward [def-pc-module-pullback], so uniqueness of left adjoints gives an isomorphism of the pulled-back coefficient modules. For any field k and structure morphism g:Y to Spec k, use the natural additive comparison [lem-sc-module-cohomology-source-comparison] between moduleCohomology and H. Apply its naturality to multiplication by the global image of each c in k. The scalar-endomorphism theorem [lem-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-scalar-endomorphism] says the module cohomology map is multiplication by that scalar; H defines its scalar action by exactly the same multiplication endomorphism. Hence the comparison is k-linear and preserves finrank. Compose with the pullback isomorphism and functorial invariance of finrankH to identify beta with the dimension in the statement. The existing finite-range and level-set conclusions now apply verbatim. Zero coefficients, degree zero and an empty base are included without choosing a point or a maximum.

lean.statement: theorem projectiveFlatCoherent_geometricCohomology_constructible {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProjective f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] [CompactSpace S] (G : X.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G) (hflat : G.IsFlatOver f) (r : ℕ) : ∃ β : S → ℕ, (∀ s : S, β s = Module.finrank (AlgebraicClosure (S.residueField s)) ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField s) (AlgebraicClosure (S.residueField s)))) ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s)).toRingedSpace r ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (AlgebraicClosure (S.residueField s)))).inv ≫ (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField s) (AlgebraicClosure (S.residueField s)))) ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s)).appTop).hom).obj ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField s) (AlgebraicClosure (S.residueField s)))) ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj G))) ∧ (Set.range β).Finite ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, Topology.IsConstructible {s : S | β s = n}
